purpose: TMB weather app lookup with variable, terrain-relevant sections

assumptions.section_logic: Variable count based on meaningful terrain/weather transitions, not equal quarters.
assumptions.ccw_timing_source: Anchored to the existing 2026 itinerary timing table.
assumptions.cw_timing_method: Reverse-direction estimate swaps ascent/descent and uses 3.5 km/h flat, 300 m/h ascent, 450 m/h descent before pace scaling.
assumptions.route_scope: Practical route family based on the existing 2026 plan: Alp Bovine, ladder-free Cheserys/Tete aux Vents, Chamonix-side finish.
assumptions.gps_note: Add validated lat/lon separately before weather API calls.
